bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
old_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-pr62-4a1c5be3
new_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-inline-query-1b571f
local_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-inline-query-20261120
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$old_tag")" || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid" || exit 64
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$local_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 65
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link-inline-query-release.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/before" "$tmp/after" "$tmp/overlay"
gh run download 44753258961 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/before" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
gh run download 44763844778 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/after" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 67
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
cmp -s "$tmp/before/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs" || exit 68
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp/after:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$local_tag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 69
cp "$tmp/after/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/overlay/gaybbs.mjs"
cat >"$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$new_tag" -f "$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" "$tmp/overlay" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 70
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new_tag")"
test "$oldid" != "$newid" || exit 71
if docker image inspect "$backup" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$backup")" = "$oldid" || exit 72
else docker tag "$oldid" "$backup"; fi
restore(){
 docker tag "$backup" "$local_tag"
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
docker tag "$new_tag" "$local_tag"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 73
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 74
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module -e '
import fs from "node:fs";
const p=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE;
const token=p?fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;
if(!token)process.exit(51);
try{const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/getMe",{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(13000)});const j=await r.json();if(!j.ok||j.result?.username!=="GayBBS_bot")process.exit(52)}catch{process.exit(53)}
' || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 76
trap - ERR
echo INLINE_UPDATE_SUBSCRIPTION_RUNTIME_IMAGE=PASS
echo TELEGRAM_BOT_AUTH=PASS
echo PREVIOUS_LINK_IMAGE_ROLLBACK_RETAINED=PASS
